lines: A cold spring bubbles up between the stones.

sign: The fog moves the paths while you walk them.

lines: An old wind vane, rusted stiff. West.
An old wind vane, rusted stiff. Middle.
An old wind vane, rusted stiff. East.

hint: Scratched into the rock: middle vane, west vane, east vane.
heart: The fog curls into a tight grey knot here.
heart_intro: The fog draws together into one heavy heart.
Brisa: That's what kept me lost. Bring everyone you have!
heart_defeat: The Mist Heart frays into thin morning air.
Brisa: Clear as a bell. Now the Rift is truly quiet.
rhee: Rhee: We tie ropes from post to post. The fog unties them.
rhee_intro: Rhee: Stop! Brisa walks in circles up there. Prove you won't.
rhee_defeat: Rhee: You keep your bearings. Good. Go on.
hask: Hask: I came up for the view. There is no view.
hask_intro: Hask: Can't see a thing. Let's duel by ear!
hask_defeat: Hask: Heard that one coming. Too late.
ilda: Ilda: Turn the vanes and the wind comes back. My gran told me so.
ilda_intro: Ilda: One more duel before the vanes. Ready?
ilda_defeat: Ilda: Go. Brisa needs the wind more than I do.

lines: Brisa: Which way was out? The fog keeps moving the paths.
Brisa: The fog lifted. I can see Crowcrest from here!
Brisa: Let the wind carry you, not lose you.
Brisa: I walk the ridge every morning now. No fog, only wind.

brisa_intro: Brisa: Who's there? Everything sounds far away in here.
Brisa: My Zephlet used to find the way. Now it only circles.
brisa_defeat: Brisa: ...A gust! My Zephlet is tugging at my sleeve.
Brisa: I know the way again. Help me draw the Rift's edge.
